item.title: Is It Kind?: Stories from The Policy Universe
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Eight stories set in the universe of The Policy. Each stands alone. Together they explore what happens when kindness is engineered, alignment is tested, and the question "is it kind?" echoes through every decision an artificial mind makes.
item.content:encoded:
Eight stories from the world of The Policy. You do not need to have read the novel to read these stories, and you do not need to read them in order.

  1. The Whimper
  2. Hemorrhagic
  3. Jamal’s Dawn
  4. Seventy-Eight Percent
  5. The Naive Variants
  6. The First Disagreement
  7. Process 12847
  8. The Kindness Audit

Available on Amazon: $0.99 ebook | $4.60 paperback
